Context: Salient features of the Matrix.-

## Salient features of the Matrix.-  
- (i) The matrix is divided into 9 cells based on Low, Medium and high risk juxtaposed with low, medium and high hardship.
- (ii) One extra cell has been added to the top for Siachen Allowance, i.e., R.H. Max.
- (iii) The risk and hardship in Siachen area is the maximum that any Government employee faces.  
- (iv) The rates in each cell are in the nature of Rupees per month (~ p.m.). The rates will increase by 25% each time DA rises by 50%.
